turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation you've described. May I ask if there's anything specific you'd like us to focus on in our inquiry?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I suggest we proceed with all haste. The matter you've brought to our attention has far-reaching implications, and I must admit that I am already beginning to form certain theories.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to keep in mind that my presence here is not merely a whim, but a necessity, one that could have far-reaching consequences for the future of Europe. I fear that I have underestimated the cunning of my adversary, and that my very life hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Pray tell, Your Majesty, what specific information do you possess that suggests your adversary's cunning exceeds your own?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have reason to believe that my adversary, Irene Adler, has somehow obtained a compromising photograph, one that could be used to blackmail me, and through me, my family and my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I find the mention of this Irene Adler to be quite intriguing. May I ask, has she given any indication of her intentions, or is she merely holding this photograph as leverage?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I would like to request a brief description of this photograph and its contents, as it may provide a crucial clue to understanding the situation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I may have spoken too candidly already, and yet, I must confess, the photograph in question depicts a moment of great... delicacy, one that could bring ruin to my family's honor if it were to fall into the wrong hands.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that I am intrigued by the mention of Irene Adler. Her reputation as a mastermind of cunning and wit precedes her, and I suspect that this photograph may be more than just a simple blackmailing tool.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, I am at a loss as to how to proceed, and I fear for the safety of my family and my kingdom, should Irene Adler's intentions be revealed.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must emphasize, Your Majesty, that discretion is paramount in this matter. We will need to tread carefully to ensure the safety of your family and the interests of your kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Tell me, Your Majesty, how is it that you came to be in possession of this photograph, and what do you believe is the exact nature of Irene Adler's involvement?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that this is not a matter of mere personal concern, but one that touches upon the very foundations of European politics. The consequences of Irene Adler's actions, if they were to become public, could be... catastrophic.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must know more about your relationship with Irene Adler, Your Majesty. It is clear that you have a personal connection to her, but I require more specifics to understand the dynamics at play.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I have already revealed too much, but I must confess that Irene Adler's... influence over me has been a complicated and troubled one. I implore you, gentlemen, to keep this in confidence, for my own sake and that of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you provide me with more clarity on the nature of your relationship with Irene Adler, Your Majesty. The intricacies of your connection to her are crucial in understanding the full scope of this matter.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am forced to confess that Irene Adler's... presence has been a constant reminder of my own powerlessness in the face of her cunning and intelligence. I fear that if her true identity were to be revealed, it could lead to a destabilization of the European balance of power, and I must do everything in my power to prevent such a catastrophe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I pose a question, Your Majesty, to clarify the nature of this catastrophe you fear? In what specific ways do you believe Irene Adler's actions could destabilize the European balance of power?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see no reason to sugarcoat the truth, Your Majesty. The revelation of Irene Adler's true identity could indeed have far-reaching consequences, but I suspect it is not the destabilization of the European balance of power that you truly fear.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I... I fear that if Irene Adler's true identity were to be revealed, it could lead to a re-evaluation of the treaties and alliances that my kingdom has formed with other European powers. The consequences could be... far-reaching, and I dare not speculate on the potential outcomes.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
